title: Filter Controller robustness audit
purpose: Audit the Filter Controller as a full Elementor product surface before the next implementation plan is written.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-026 is complete and Guilherme has reported visual overflow, dynamic tag sensitivity, shop-biased defaults, and the recurring risk of fixing only the named example.
exit_condition: The robustness audit tasks produce code-grounded findings, source paths, risk ranking, and a follow-up implementation/test plan without applying one-off fixes first.
required_outputs: dynamic tag and preset binding report
acceptance_criteria: Every audit task cites source files, control IDs, render selectors, and preset fields where applicable.
Examples mentioned by Guilherme are treated as signals, not as the whole scope.
No new implementation task is created from one filter type until the per-type audit matrix has been reviewed.
Guilherme remains final QA for interaction-heavy Elementor editor and visual craft decisions.
